legs.note: Reported verbatim; nothing ran. The seek took a fraction and nothing else, `position` was an optional string no lane shape could fill, and `navigate_back`'s corpus is "Go back" — a zero-argument verb one short sentence away from leaving the page.
legs.say: Can you go back two minutes in the video

summary: The reported sentence: a length of time, backwards, resolved against the video's clock into a place on the track.
